diagnostic_rules.color_splash: Native visual review must show the existing crimson paperweight as sole colored region and every remaining region achromatic. Read-only RGB spread outside a generous prop mask can corroborate visual tint; tolerance diagnostics do not waive the contract.
diagnostic_rules.lifted_blacks: Inspect deepest roots and shelf recesses at native scale for clearly visible neutral-charcoal floor and preserved strand/wood distinctions. The authorial approximately 45/255 cue is a rendering guide, not a new requester lock or substitute for visible gray.
diagnostic_rules.skin_detail: Inspect cheeks at native scale for locally smooth tonal transitions plus independent fine pores/natural variations; preserved face/hair configuration and no artificial facial-geometry alteration are separate checks.
